annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents OneCoin as a profitable investment, gives a one-year value expectation, links buying a coin to starting mining, and urges viewers to join early, get started, and take action. Although the speaker says sales and bonuses are not the focus and discusses identifying fake cryptocurrency, the presentation is still framed around succeeding in the OneCoin business and promotes investment and participation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The presentation links buying a coin and joining early to mining, holding returns and anticipated coin appreciation. The slide explicitly identifies a purchased trading course within a product package and connects that instruction to opportunities to trade tokens for profit. It does not establish a separate course price.

evidence.observation: The webinar is presented as information for speaking to prospects and succeeding in the OneCoin business.
evidence.quote: it will give you some cutting edge information when you're talking to your prospects because knowledge is everything and This webinar will really give you the knowledge you need to succeed in the business of OneCoin.

evidence.observation: A OneCoin slide displays 'Join early for profit!' beside a rising price graphic and says the price will start at 0.50 EUR per coin.
The speaker links buying a coin to starting mining.
evidence.quote: As soon as someone buys a coin, they start the actual mining

evidence.observation: The speaker claims that holding the coin longer offers more money to make.
evidence.quote: the longer we hold it the more money is there to make.

evidence.observation: A slide says a product package purchases a OneAcademy trading course, then describes trading tokens for profit and later joining mining to profit from coin value increases.
The speaker gives an attributed opinion that the coin's long-term price can only rise.
evidence.quote: So the price, in my opinion long-term can only go up, because there is no inflation.

evidence.observation: The speaker says the magnitude of any price change cannot be specified and depends on members, transactions and work.
evidence.quote: Nobody can tell you buy how much. It depends a lot on the members and the transactions and the effort in work we do

evidence.observation: The speaker says bonuses and sales are not the webinar's main focus.
evidence.quote: We will not speak today about bonuses, we will not speak about sales too much.
